items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: Just like if you took a football player or even a basketball player and put him up against James McEnroe -- he wouldn't last one second.

ctx.x: circle like you do, like, in Central Park here or wherever they've got these skating rinks. It's round and round she goes. And if you want to do anything, you've got to go out in the middle and do a Figure-Eight or some damn thing. That's bullshit! Ice skating is ice skating. You really go when you skate. You make sudden stops and jerks and turns and whirls -- that's skatin'! Like hockey players. I mean, that's an ice skater. He ain't one of these guys that puts his hand behind his back and goes...you know, that…

Just like if you took a football player or even a basketball player and put him up against James McEnroe -- he wouldn't last one second. Not if he was going to chase those balls. Because McEnroe would play with him like a cat with a mouse. That's why... I can't understand why people...why tennis isn't more recognized. It's becoming more...
